items.claim: Dropped weasel payload lands at the paste offset, not the drop point
kitSweep no longer reaches the presets
items.note: The sweep now also reads the `presets` entries of core, editing, path-tools and text-tools. A new test checks that every preset on `@weasel-js/editing/presets` is reached; before the fix, `view`, `move`, `resize` and `rotate` were missed. This only changes tests, so it has no changeset.

items.claim: Repeated Cmd+V stacks every paste on one spot
items.note: plus 0f9f1654b5, which allowlists the new last-paste map in `check:part-caches`. This was already listed as Open in `docs/unruled.md`, so I made the call and rewrote that entry. Cmd+V now steps on from that canvas's last paste of the same payload, remembered per paste adapter. Still open there: Cmd+V lands at the adapter's offset, while the Paste button lands at the pointer by default. A also noted that the OS path always labels the history entry "Paste" and ignores `pasteLabel`. Not a defect: the handler cannot see the hook's options. I left it unchanged.

items.claim: SVG and raster files dropped together stack on one spot
items.note: Each file now cascades by its place among all the files the arrival carried, and `ghostBounds` numbers files the same way. A file nobody can claim still holds its place, so it leaves a gap in the cascade.

items.claim: A payload containing `</metadata>` cannot be pasted back from the SVG flavor
items.note: The extractor now reads whole CDATA sections before it looks for the closing tag.

items.claim: kit:svg makes two nodes from an SVG file plus its text/plain markup
`writeOsClipboard` leaves a rejecting promised flavor unhandled when there is no clipboard API
`useSelection` seeds `initial` only into the first `scene` store it is given
